[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Lepira''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps']] [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Flying as [[Gold Four/Legends|Gold Four]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
Lepira learned to fly a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by racing in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], before serving as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CCGLL">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Lepira}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was present in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna's]] briefing, where he sat next to [[Elyhek Rue/Legends|Elyhek Rue]] and in front of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="ANH" /> He subsequently flew an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-pitted<ref name="CCGG4">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 4}}</ref> [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Gold Four/Legends|Gold Four]], flying point for [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and fending off [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|fighters]] to clear a path for the Rebels to reach the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] vulnerable [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust port]]. Lepira and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R5-F7]], were killed when their Y-wing was shot down in the battle.<ref name="Hasbro" />
